systems.system: SISMA (Sistema de informação para a saúde para a monitoria e avaliação)

note: The passages name SISMA only as "MISAU's DHIS2", the data source for disbursement-linked indicators counting district hospitals rehabilitated and connected to the internet; they do not describe what it reports, where it is keyed or which tiers use it, so it is unclassified and gives no fact.
